attested_fields.verification_procedure: restored hosts are rebuilt from a known-good image, malware-scanned, integrity-checked against expected file hashes, and smoke-tested in an isolated VLAN before cutover
attested_fields.acceptance_criteria: clean EDR scan, matching baseline hashes, and passing functional smoke tests are all required before return to service
attested_fields.sign_off_role: the on-call SRE lead and the incident commander must both sign off before the asset is returned to operations
